name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
⚡ Google Drive Folder Batch & Multi-Format Fix: Properly downloads images (.jpg, .png) and videos (.mp4) without validation failures or corrupted extensions
🎬 Clean Timeline Labels: Replaced 00:00 on video/image footages with dedicated PHOTO / HD FOOTAGE tags
🔌 Adobe CEP Plugin Bundled Update: Synchronized server.js daemon with Google Drive folder multi-file scraper and query param support
📁 Google Drive Shared Folder Multi-Footage Extraction: Full batch detection and multi-file listing for Drive folders without HTTP 400 errors
📸 Carousel Selection & Direct Download: Checkbox selectors on slides, Select All / Deselect, and 1-tap Download Selected without extra prompts
